issue.title: Auth - Login
issue.description:
## 💡 User Story
As a user,
I want to log into my account,
so that I can manage my recipes.

## 📋Acceptance Criteria
- [x]  A "Login" button is present at the top of the page when the user is not logged in
- [x]  When clicked, the user is brought to a Login page with fields: email, password
- [x]  A "Login" button exists below the form
- [x]  If a required field is missing, a validation error is shown
- [x]  If the username or password is incorrect, the error is shown
- [x]  Upon successful login, a session cookie in saved in the browser
- [x]  The "Login" button is not visible when the user is already logged in

## 🔍 Tech Analysis
### Backend
- Controller-Service-Repository design pattern
- User repository for direct user related crud via the orm
- Auth service for containing auth logic (hasing, jwt generation, business validation)
- Auth controller for handling http (requests, reponses, cookie setting)
- Auth router for directing traffic to the controller
- Validation middleware for handling incoming post requests

logs.description: Created the User and Role models; Added a seed file for inserting roles + an admin user; generated a new prisma client using updated models; Created init migration.

Added the middleware and helpers:
Validate middleware for checking request bodies; Authenticate middleware checking for if the jwt validity; jwt helper for generation tokens; password helper for password salt gen, and hashing/hash compare.
Added validation schemas and types for login and register bodies, the schemas will get used by the validate middleware.
